Natsionalna Elektricheska Kompania EAD (NEK EAD) was incorporated in late 1991 and over the years it has established its position in the power industry and the economy of the Republic of Bulgaria. The mission of NEK EAD is to provide safe, efficient and uninterrupted power supply. NEK EAD is a sole-owner joint-stock company. Since 2008 the capital of NEK is held by Bulgarian Energy Holding EAD. The main businesses of NEK EAD include electricity generation and trading. The Company is managed by a three-member Board of Directors.

NEK EAD operates one of the largest dams and hydropower schemes in the country, applying stringent requirements on their O&M safety and efficiency. The Company lies at the heart of the electric power system of Bulgaria, producing electricity at 31 hydro-power and pumped storage hydro-power plants, with a total installed generating capacity of 2737 MW and pumping capacity of 931 MW. The flexible generation facilities of the company have a key role in ensuring security of supply and reliability and security of the grid system of Bulgaria. The total capacity of the dam reservoirs operated by NEK EAD represents 55% of the total controlled water resources in the Republic of Bulgaria.

Licenses issued to NEK EAD by the Energy and Water Regulatory Commission:
- Hydro (HPP&PS) generation license;
- Public power supply license expanded to include the rights and obligations of a "Special Balancing Group Coordinator".
- Electricity trading license expanded to include the rights and obligations of a "Standard Balancing Group Coordinator".
- Supplier of Last Resort license expanded to include the rights and obligations of a "Special Balancing Group Coordinator".

entityDescription:
With around 4,800 students, the Dresden University of Applied Sciences (HTW Dresden) is the second largest university in the state capital of Saxony, Germany. Founded in 1992, it is now one of the top German universities of applied sciences. It offers more than 40 degree courses in the fields of civil engineering, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, computer science, economics, geoinformatics, agriculture, environment, chemistry and design which lead to Bachelor's, Master's and Diplom degrees.

Teaching and research are closely linked at HTW Dresden and are strongly practice-oriented. Students can participate in research projects at an early stage, benefit from close contacts with industrial partners and also have the opportunity to do a doctorate as part of a cooperative doctoral program.

Research at HTW Dresden is primarily oriented towards the three interdisciplinary profile lines: Securing Natural Resources, Developing Sustainable Mobility and Infrastructure, and Designing, Networking and Digitalizing the Economy and Work. With its application-oriented research, the university is an important partner, especially for SMEs in Saxony, and is very well networked with the numerous technology and research centers in Dresden as a science location.

The University of Applied Sciences supports start-ups from the university environment in the development and implementation of innovative business ideas and arranges contacts with cooperation partners in business and industry. In addition to excellent study conditions and a first-class education, students in Dresden can expect an environment with a high quality of life, art and culture, great leisure activities and a beautiful landscape.The degrees obtained at HTW Dresden are highly recognized by companies as well as research and educational institutions. This is proven not only by current studies and university rankings, but above all by the successful placement of the graduates in practice.

AERIANE SA is a Belgian company established in 1988, provides a spectrum of Engineering, Design, prototyping, and high-performance mechanical and composite production services. It is equipped with a 5-axis machining center designed for complex and large-sized parts.
In an increasingly specialized industrial landscape, AERIANE acts as a singular and responsive point of contact, delivering a comprehensive solution from design to manufacturing, installation, or maintenance.
With more than 33 years of experience, AERIANE has cultivated a reputation for responsiveness, and a steadfast commitment to quality and reliability in the diverse and ambitious projects it has undertaken throughout the years.

In its history, AERIANE has encountered numerous opportunities across various domains. Commencing with aircraft manufacturing, the two founders were presented with the chance to embark on an R&D delta wing project. This early venture compelled them to swiftly innovate, creating and testing solutions for this new version of the glider.
Among the notable and remarkable opportunities, AERIANE played a role in the design team for the Princess Elisabeth Research Station. Additionally, AERIANE contributed to the OPERA project, an international collaboration with CERN in Geneva. The objective of the Opera project was the detection of neutrinos emitted from CERN accelerators, situated 731km away in Gran Sasso (central Italy). AERIANE was responsible for manufacturing a network of scintillation fibers that aided in locating the occurrence of neutrinos. 
Furthermore, AERIANE has amassed significant experience in mechanical design through the two "rolling floor projects" commissioned by IBA. This expertise is continually evolving in ongoing development efforts.
